evidence: Touches src/net_processing.cpp to replace an assertion crash in GETBLOCKTXN message handling with a fatal graceful shutdown and alters how block processing exceptions are handled in P2P paths.
rationale: Prevents an assertion crash when handling GETBLOCKTXN during block read errors, replacing it with a graceful fatal shutdown. While triggered by rare filesystem read failures, it avoids an abrupt process abort in peer message processing.
